name: @openharness/desktop
description: The real desktop code: thin Electron host. Main process boots the forked DSH Host Cordis generation and the sandboxed renderer loads the official Web UI over the loopback HTTP/WebSocket carrier. No IPC inference channel and no Electron API in the page.
